construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict schema_version=1 object: fixture_label, catalog {currency, products [{sku,name,price,stock}]}, customers [{customer_id,persona,consent {gdpr_personalization,ccpa_personalization}}], orders [{order_id,customer_id,items [{sku,quantity,shown_price,shown_stock}]}], clickstream [{event_id,customer_id,order_id,sku,action,shown_price,shown_stock}], feedback [{feedback_id,customer_id,order_id,sku,text,provenance}], personalize.
shared_schema.formats: Catalog JSON feed and clickstream event-log array in one JSON envelope. Prices are nonnegative two-decimal strings; stocks and quantities are integers, not booleans. Purchase events require an order; views may use null order_id.
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, fixture_label, notice, counts, catalog, evidence, themes, personalized_insights. Errors: {status:error,error:message} with exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function precedes analysis. Strict fields, identifiers, referential integrity, duplicate IDs, consent, provenance and catalog snapshots. CLI additionally rejects malformed JSON, duplicate object keys and non-finite literals.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single stage only: validated input -> scoped deduplication -> exact evidence table -> keyword themes referencing canonical evidence IDs -> shared JSON output.

behavior.deduplication: NFKC normalization, case folding and whitespace collapse; scoped by customer, order and SKU. Lexicographically smallest feedback ID is canonical, all source IDs retained.
behavior.themes: Deterministic whole-word keyword matching for delivery, packaging, price_value, product_quality and availability; unmatched evidence is other. Multi-label counts may overlap.
behavior.excerpts: Entire original canonical feedback text copied verbatim, never generated or presented as a real endorsement.
behavior.personalization: Disabled by default. When requested, all included customers need both GDPR and CCPA demonstrative consent flags. Returns only each customer's observed theme names.
behavior.catalog: All displayed price and stock snapshots must exactly equal catalog values; output catalog is copied without invention. No inventory reservation or historical-price modeling.
behavior.clickstream: Validated context only; never converted into review evidence.
behavior.privacy: Synthetic identifiers and personas only. Consent gates personalization, not aggregate analysis. Demonstrative rules are not compliance certification.

test_outcomes.cli: Passed; one JSON object with status ok, exit 0; 3 received, 2 unique, 1 duplicate removed
test_outcomes.error_behavior: Missing file and missing argument subprocess checks returned JSON status error with exit 2; malformed JSON and invalid schemas verified through main
